name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and configures Nginx for three sites with virtual hosts, development TLS certificates, sample content, and host security controls including fail2ban, firewall rules, SSH hardening, and sysctl settings.

name: cache
description: Installs and enables Memcached and Redis, configures Redis listening and authentication, creates required directories, and applies Redis service configuration.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys a FastAPI tutorial application with Python, a virtual environment, PostgreSQL database and user setup, environment configuration, and a systemd service.
